Name: SOC 1 Type II (Financial Reporting & ICFR) for Oracle SaaS
Description: Service Organization Control (SOC 1 Type II) framework evaluating controls relevant to Internal Control over Financial Reporting (ICFR) across Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP and HCM.

Requirements.Name: Control Environment - Logical Access & Privileged Identity
Requirements.Description: Logical access to financial systems is restricted to authorized individuals based on job responsibility and least privilege principles.

Requirements.Name: Control Activities - Separation of Incompatible Duties
Requirements.Description: Duties within the financial ERP system are segregated such that no individual can control all phases of a financial transaction.

Requirements.Name: Information & Communication - Audit Logging and Change Tracking
Requirements.Description: Transactions and administrative modifications in Oracle Fusion ERP are logged and retained in an audit trail.

Requirements.Name: Monitoring Activities - API Security and Network Perimeters
Requirements.Description: Access to ERP APIs and management interfaces is restricted via network controls and scoped OAuth credentials.
